steps.text: Maria.
Maria, you are gifted with a pair of pegasian eyes.
Maria. Stand. Come, come forth.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ugh?!

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Haa... haah...! You dodged it!

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Very well, I'll let you keep your right hand for just a little longer... Just a little longer.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (—These aren't tears... It's sticky... Is it blood?)

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (...So much blood...)

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (My heart's beating way too fast... I...)

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Pathetic. The way you swing your weapon is no better than those clowns knocking at the knightly orders' doors. It's laughable.

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Aside from your looks, you are nothing like the Radiant Knight.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I... I'm not going to lose!

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Good, now I want to tear your face off even more, you naive noble prick!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Ingra! He's chasing her like a storm!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: This is the most destructive match the Roar Arena has seen this event—! The Butcher of the Field! 'Brassrust' Ingra!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Just last month, at the season's first event, poor 'Foehn' got absolutely decimated when the 'Brassrust' kept pummeling him until all of his limbs were crushed!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: You heard that right! He pummeled with his bare hands! That's definitely not the kind of thing you'd expect a knight carrying a giant axe to do!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: All eyes are on Maria Nearl here at the Roar Arena today, but is this also where we see her meet a bloody fate? Let us know what you in the audience think!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Just like that! 'Brassrust' Ingra! Smear the battlefield with your opponent's blood!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Haaahh... haaahhh...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (Everything feels so heavy—)

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria! Just forfeit!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: It's one match! There are other chances to score the points you need—!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria—!
Auntie Zofia... What are you talking about?
I can't hear you... I feel dizzy... My shield feels so heavy...
What am I... doing... The knight competitions... In the arena...
I need to... open my eyes!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Haa... haah...

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Hah! Not a bad counter—That really gives me all the more reason to tear you apart!

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: But it'll be no fun if we end this so quickly. I'll smear your blood all over that irritating face... the Radiant Knight's face!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: We both know... you're at your limit too.

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Hah! A little blood's not going to stop me!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria!
Well... I didn't expect Ingra to join the fray so soon...
The National Council let him go early. Hmph, it's like the whole trial was just a sham.
Looks like the corporation coughed up quite a bit of money for him.
Uh huh... the Rose Paper Union's full of money anyway.
It really pisses me off. They're raking in money manipulating public opinion, and other unscrupulous means. That commentator even dared to talk about it openly in a public event.
That just says they aren't afraid.
Yeah, I mean, what do they have to be afraid of?
Well, they have us to be afraid of. Ingra's a bad loser, and I'll absolutely destroy him.
Come on, didn't we agree to let me fight him?
Before that... If the young Nearl doesn't come up with an idea soon, she won't make it out of this in one piece.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: —Her blood is still in her body! Maria Nearl is much more stubborn than any of us could've thought!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: What are you waiting for? Doesn't a knight like her just tear at your heartstrings?! Don't forget! Thanks to the generosity of the good-hearted souls at Roar Guards Company, this season's commission fee is just half the normal rate!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: —Hold on! Something's happening here!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The two of them are at a standoff, but Maria's laid down her shield! What is happening here?! Is she hoping to take on Ingra's giant axe with that fragile sword of hers?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: There's an enormous difference in both size and power!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: I can't emphasize this enough—! Commission's half off! Isn't this act of courage worth a few dozen gold coins?!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Hahh... haahh...

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: ...Not bad, kid... A faint light envelops your blade. Is this your last gasp?

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Ha, excellent! I'll rip your arms out, and gag you with your own flesh—
I must win... I must...
What am I doing... Are you meant to kill your opponent in the knight sports?
I don't need my shield... I can't block his axe...
He's hurt too, but he doesn't care... He's like a monster, and he enjoys killing...
How should I... face an enemy like him... An enemy? Isn't he a knight?
A knight...?
'To be a knight is to be the noble light that illuminates the land...'

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ahh—!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: O-Owww...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...Came around finally?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Auntie...? What... happened...? Oh.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Do you remember now?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...Did I lose?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Yep.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: But Ingra passed out too. Neither of your scores changed at all.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I-I see. Phew... That's good—

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: It's not good! You're hurt!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: You should've forfeited the match, going up against an opponent like that! It's just a single match! There are so many ways for us to get those points back!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: If you just want to get a title and keep your family's nobility, there's no reason to go that far—

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I... I never thought about forfeiting, not even once.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Do you have any idea how lucky you are to get out of a fight against Ingra in one piece?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: If you get hurt again, what good does getting into the Major do to you?!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...He's really strong, but...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: He's not like the other knights. He comes from an insanely well-off family, and he's only in the competition to hurt people. He lives for it. That's the kind of man Olmer Ingra is.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria, if you get hurt like this again, I won't let you fight anymore.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Listen to me!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: F-Fine...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Don't move so much. Get some rest.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: That match ended in a draw, but you'll have more and more companies trying to woo you... Marcin and I will turn them down for now. Try to rest up and get better.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Yeah...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Oh... What's that sword?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...That's the sword I used to carry. I dug it out while you were training the other day.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: But why are you carrying that sword specifically...?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (Even though Zofia's already...)

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: No reason at all.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: But if something bad happens to you because of him, I'll kill him personally, even if it means I'll have to face the National Council.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Y-You're way overthinking it...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...Can I see it? It kinda looks like it hasn't been used in a while.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: No. Get some rest.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I might start to rust if I lie in bed all day...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: No dice.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Please, Zofia! Auntie! I won't ask for anything else! I'll be good and rest up!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: *Sigh*... You're becoming more and more like your sister...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Take it. Don't you do anything weird with it. I'm quite fond of it.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Eh... This is pretty dusty...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: That's the proof that I treasure it!

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Where are you two going, carrying all that stuff with you?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: We're going to pay Maria a visit.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: I will never forgive Ingra for doing that to our girl...

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Spare her the noise and give her some peace and quiet. Zofia will take care of Maria.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Well, I can't just sit around and do nothing! Did you see that last swing Ingra took at her? What happens if that comes back to haunt her?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: We've got an old knight and an old craftsman here. There's bound to be something we can do to help.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: What if you run into Młynar instead? Do you think he won't throw you two out the door?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: ...That prick wouldn't dare do that to us when his old man was still around, and I know when to run if it comes to it!

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: ...Hmm, the moment the two of them left, I got a new customer. They just might be the albatross around my neck.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Welcome. It's been a while since we've had such a beauty in here. What can I get you?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: ...This one has a pretty name. Let's go with this one, the 'Thorn Tear.'
